author: Andres
html: Would you tell us how to install Autopo? I went to your website, then to Github, downloaded the Win 64 zip file and there’s no executable inside 🙁

author: Andrea Vacondio
html: There is a .bat script in the bin sub-directory, dosen’t it work?

author: Maurizio
html: Hi Andrea, your Autopo started like a charme on my MX-Linux. I had to figure out how to use it as i am not an i18n geek and there is no howto. But i discovered, you need to have a folder with a new .pot and all the empty .po files of the languages you want to translate. The AI striked but I will find out how to handle it. Mille grazie!
